title: Frankfurt Airport - Wikipedia
content: # Frankfurt Airport. | Frankfurt Airport  *Flughafen Frankfurt Main* | |. | Hub for | * AeroLogic * Discover Airlines * Lufthansa * Lufthansa Cargo * Lufthansa City Airlines * Lufthansa CityLine |. **Frankfurt Airport** (German: *Flughafen Frankfurt Main* ) (IATA: **FRA**, ICAO: **EDDF**) is Germany's busiest international airport by passenger numbers, located in Frankfurt, Germany's fifth-largest city. The airport is operated by Fraport and serves as the main hub for Lufthansa, including Lufthansa City Airlines, Lufthansa CityLine, Discover Airlines and Lufthansa Cargo as well as Condor and AeroLogic. Frankfurt Airport is the busiest airport by passenger traffic in Germany as well as the 6th busiest in Europe after London–Heathrow, Istanbul, Paris–Charles de Gaulle, Amsterdam Airport Schiphol and Adolfo Suárez Madrid–Barajas Airport. It also had a freight throughput of 2.076 million tonnes in 2015 and is the busiest airport in Europe by cargo traffic.

title: Distance between Airports: Our Flight Distance Calculator (Miles & Kilometers)
content: Home » Tools » Distance between Airports: Our Flight Distance Calculator (Miles & Kilometers). # Distance between Airports: Our Flight Distance Calculator (Miles & Kilometers). The distance between two airports is not only important for earning miles but also for receiving compensation within the framework of EU air passenger rights. Simply enter the IATA codes of the departure (layover) and destination airports, and we will provide you with the distance in miles and kilometres:. To quickly and easily calculate the distance for multiple flights, you need to enter the route using IATA codes connected with a hyphen (-). If you are not particularly familiar with IATA codes, you can also search for an airport at any time. We calculate the distance between two airports not based on the actual flight route but using the geodesic method. This is the shortest line between two points on a sphere, in this case, the Earth.
